Here is a complete research conduct on [Bank Marketing dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/222/bank+marketing), where we derive a profile for future campaign based on data. In this research we do explanatory data analysis, modeling customer behaviour using statistical logistic regression and profile the population based on obtained knowledge.
